title: Tavern0.6.167 — cursor and original fluid animation
native_evidence_scope:
Restores Java integer cursor movement inside each tick and animated water/lava surfaces in barrels and pressing tubs, including original sprite alpha. Preserves recipes, storage, model geometry and native/companion controls.

Actual client latency, rendering and full Java parity remain pending.
